title: Craft Blend 3-Mix Trio #28 (CzechBohemian+KoreanNajeon+NorwegianRosemaling / PeruvianNazca+ChineseCizhou+KlimtMosaic / CroatianHvar+PortugueseAzulejo+VietnameseSonMai)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Chinese woman in her mid 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair matte skin with a soft powdery finish, thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, a poised, glamorous expression, bold and confident, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glossy finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Czech Bohemian crystal-engraving motif (a deep black ground with fine engraved silver linework, wide silver bands, dense engraved floral facets) dominates one zone. Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer (glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines, wide mother-of-pearl bands, dense dense scrollwork) dominates the second zone. Norwegian rosemaling folk painting (a deep forest-green ground with bold cream and gold acanthus scrollwork, wide gold bands, dense acanthus scrollwork) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.

Left woman's footwear: extreme thigh-high stiletto boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Korean woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair ivory skin, sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, a cold, commanding gaze, bold and confident, sleek silver-grey hair styled in a short pixie cut, real living eyes. Long round nails, chrome finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Peruvian Nazca painted pattern (a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures, wide gold bands, dense stepped geometric borders) dominates one zone. Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic (a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls, wide carved cream bands, dense leaf scrolls) dominates the second zone. Klimt-inspired organic mosaic (an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders, wide gold bands, dense organic curved mosaic) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: caught mid-jump, feet off the ground.

Center woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto studded boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult Vietnamese woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, soft porcelain skin, delicate rose-pink eyeshadow, glossy soft-coral lips, bold and confident, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in a high top-knot bun, real living eyes. Long round nails, glittery finish.

Right woman's physique: An enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework (an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework, wide gold bands, dense fine filigree linework) dominates one zone. Portuguese azulejo tile (a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders, wide cobalt bands, dense repeating panel scrollwork) dominates the second zone. Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer (deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms, wide gold-leaf bands, dense eggshell-white scrollwork) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: leaning one arm on a window frame.

Right woman's footwear: extreme needle heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
